//: shared/content.ts, compiled to the /content.js the browser fetches.
scripts/build-modules.ts runs this and rebases the one specifier
that reaches out of shared/ into aab/. It is a second config
rather than a flag on shared/tsconfig.json because that one is
the answer to 'does shared/ typecheck', and noEmit is what keeps
it an answer rather than an artefact.
rootDir is the REPOSITORY, not shared/. allowJs is on so the four
curriculum.js ladders resolve, and an import outside rootDir is an
error, so the root is what covers both. The generator reads
shared/content.js out of the output and ignores the rest.
removeComments stays off: this repository's comments carry the
constraints, and a served module a reader opens in a browser is
the one place they are read without the repository to hand.
outDir is overridden by the generator on every run. It names a
scratch directory rather than nothing so that running this by
hand cannot drop a content.js beside its own source, which is
the one file in shared/ that would then be read instead of it.
